original: snānacihnopanyāsaḥ | pulakitā'pi tanvī vartata iti hṛdi sthito'nvayaḥ | tena ca snānena pulakitā tanuḥ kiñjiducchvasitā bhavati, iyaṃ tu na tatheti tatikyeśajanitāveva tānavapulakodgamāviti marmeddāṭanam |
